rules.sentence: Although only 1 dominant allele is needed for the disease phenotype, 2 dominant alleles will lead to a more severe presentation in those cells.
Dyskeratosis and acantholysis on histopathology characterize Darier disease.
Darier disease has demonstrated both type 1 and type 2 mosaicism, giving rise to segmental type 1 and segmental type 2 variants of Darier disease, respectively.
